title: Collapse a technician group in Tech View and it stays collapsed after a reload
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API: display List, no collapsed groups and no other Tech View or Board View layout keys
A throwaway customer with a unique name of at most 30 characters and no pinned note, with one vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location
One work order for that customer, with one line and lead technician A

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders, pick Tech View from the display switcher, and search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: Technician A's group shows a count of 1 with the work order as its row, and its control reads Collapse A
The work order row leaves the table, A's header stays with its count of 1, and its control reads Expand A

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold at the same URL
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View reopens, and A's group is still collapsed with a count of 1, and the work order row is not shown under it

The work order row is back under A's header

Collapsing a technician group hides its work orders but keeps its header and count; the collapse is restored from the account after a reload; and expanding brings the rows back
